title: Q版木雕人偶
prompt: Hyper-realistic carved wooden figurine of [CHARACTER], chibi proportions (big head, short body), standing on a plain wood block. Keep key face traits and iconic [OUTFIT/PROP]. Visible wood grain and chisel marks, matte finish. Warm studio light, soft shadow, seamless beige background. Centered full-body, slight 3/4 angle, shallow depth of field (85mm look). Ultra-detailed, photoreal, warm sepia grading. Aspect ratio [3:4].
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松生成超写实 Q 版木雕人偶，温暖复古的棕褐色调风格，适合品牌设计、肖像摄影和玩具收藏，展现细腻木纹与精致细节。
